documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of EGM
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: SK Minerals & Additives Limited reported a 50% increase in revenue to Rs. 318 crores for FY26, with EBITDA margin improving to 10% and PAT margin rising to 6%. Management highlighted expansion into polymer additives, specifically halogen-free flame retardants, and outlined a planned capex of Rs. 20 crores over the next two years to scale manufacturing capacity to 18,000 metric tons. The company noted current capacity utilization around 70% overall, with food and feed segments operating at approximately 95%.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted strong demand and inquiry levels from foreign buyers for their newly developed flame-retardant products.
demand_outlook.quote: This product is good and we have received interest from foreign buyers also.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated they acquired 9.6 acres of land for developing polymer additives and polymer compound facilities to expand manufacturing.
capex_expansion.quote: First of all, this 9.6 acre land which we have taken is for developing our polymer additives and polymer compound facility, whereas specified that in next 12 to 18 months, we will be taking our manufacturing capabilities to 18,000 metric tons.

capex_expansion.claim: The total manufacturing capacity is targeted to increase from the current 600 metric ton to 18,000 metric ton in a phased manner over 12 to 18 months.
capex_expansion.quote: So, from the current capacity of 600 metric ton, we will take it to 18,000 metric ton in phase manner of next 12 to 18 months.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for FY26 increased from 9% to 10% and PAT increased from 5% to 6%.
margins_costs.quote: and our EBITDA margins have increased from 9% to 10% and PAT has increased from 5% to 6%.

margins_costs.claim: Management explained that margin contraction in the second half of the year was caused by an increase in raw material prices starting from January.
margins_costs.quote: It is because of the increase in the prices of raw materials. And as I have said prices have increased specifically, from January onwards, the prices of raw material have increased.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing gross margins currently stand at approximately 30%, while trading products yield 21%.
margins_costs.quote: So, in terms of gross margin, which we make from manufacturing, right now it's 30%. Whereas, in terms of our trading product, it is 21%.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects margins from polymer additives to reach around 40%.
margins_costs.quote: whereas from polymer additives, we feel that the margins would be 40%.

orders_capacity.claim: The current order book stands at approximately Rs. 55 crores, with Rs. 42 crores coming from government contracts and the rest from private customers.
orders_capacity.quote: Currently, order book is around about Rs. 55 crore and it depends upon the customer.

orders_capacity.claim: Current total installed capacity stands at 6,600 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: The current capacity is 6600 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization for the food and feed segments is approximately 95%.
orders_capacity.quote: current capacity utilization is approximately 95% in food and feed segment and we have set up one food segment also which is almost optimally used.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilizes bank credit lines and IPO proceeds for funding the planned capex.
capital_allocation.quote: We have the credit lines available for CAPEX from the banks also. And we have some part of the IPO proceeds which we have raised for CAPEX.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical scenarios have impacted import trading stock availability as three-month buffer stocks dry up.
risks_headwinds.quote: In terms of the import trading, yes, it has impacted because we have three months’ stock always available with us. So, that stock is getting dried up.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects the polymer additives plant to be fully utilized and operational within the next three to six months.
management_commitments.quote: So, maybe in next three to six months, we will be having full capacity running for this polymer additives plant.

management_commitments.claim: Total manufacturing capacity will be scaled to 18,000 metric tons in a phased manner over the next 12 to 18 months.
management_commitments.quote: So, from the current capacity of 600 metric ton, we will take it to 18,000 metric ton in phase manner of next 12 to 18 months.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to file three patents within the next six months.
management_commitments.quote: But in next six months, we will try to file three patents.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
